EXPERIENCE · MARCH 2026 — PRESENT

Research Student Assistant

University of Luxembourg · SpaceR Research Group

Engineering and robotics research

My work at SpaceR focuses on the design, development, and integration of robotic systems for advanced research applications. It combines mechanical engineering, electronics, tactile sensing, and software to develop and test functional robotic solutions.

My activities cover different stages of engineering development, from mechanical design and simulation to hardware integration, tactile perception, control implementation, and experimental testing.

Main areas of work

  • Mechanical Design and Simulation: Development of mechanical components and robotic end-effectors, including Finite Element Analysis of compliant and fractal structures.
  • Robotics and Control Systems: Integration of motors, sensors, controllers, and robotic systems through hardware and software development.
  • Tactile Sensing and Perception: Integration and use of tactile sensors to detect contact, measure interaction forces, and support robotic manipulation and grasping.
  • Learning and Intelligent Manipulation: Exploration of Learning from Demonstration and data-driven methods for robotic task execution.
  • Experimental Development: Prototyping, sensor integration, data acquisition, testing, and performance evaluation.
